title: Kenworth K200 high tensile polished Aluminium custom built FUPS compliant Bullbar, #79
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile polished aluminium custom built FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar, Extended 450mm deep reinforced main channel and heavy duty box uprights with 88mm pipes. Option of 75mm or 100mm pipe available. Main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. A lift assist spring is fitted to aid easy access for cab tilt. Custom driving light mounts to suit light bar plus additional mounts to customer requirements.
